text: Why does your dog tilt its head when you talk?
One idea: its muzzle blocks part of your face.
In one owner survey, long-muzzled dogs tilted more often than flat-faced ones.
asr: In one owner survey, long muzzle dogs tilted more often than flat-faced ones.

text: But a twenty twenty-one study found something stranger.
asr: But a 2021 study found something stranger.

text: Dogs that had learned their toys' names tilted their heads very often when they heard those names.
And each dog tended to tilt to the same side.
So that little tilt may mean one thing.
Say the name of their favorite ball, and watch.
